changelog: - The affiliate partner list (`/admin/affiliates/partners`) shows an open invitation as "Invitation sent · <when>" (or "expired") with a small "Send again" instead of the "Send invitation" button; a partner with an account shows neither. `listPartners()` carries the newest open invitation per partner (#3962).

en: The partner list now shows when an invitation was sent, with a small "Send again" — the invite button stays only for partners never invited.
tr: Partner listesi artık davetin ne zaman gönderildiğini ve küçük bir "Tekrar gönder" bağlantısını gösteriyor; davet butonu yalnızca hiç davet edilmemiş partnerlerde kalıyor.
de: Die Partnerliste zeigt jetzt, wann eine Einladung gesendet wurde, mit einem kleinen „Erneut senden“ – die Einladen-Schaltfläche bleibt nur bei noch nie eingeladenen Partnern.
